title: Stripe vs Square
description: Stripe vs Square: stored editorial scores are Stripe 4.7/5 and Square 4.3/5. Stripe is the provisional recorded pick, but the scores and winner rationale have not passed a source-linked evidence audit. The applicable processing fees depend on payment method, region, and transaction type; verify current terms directly with each vendor.

features.name: Free tier availability
features.tool1Detail: Stripe offers a free trial period to evaluate the platform. Free tiers include core functionality with usage limits.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides a free tier for small teams. Freemium models reduce initial investment risk.

features.name: Entry-level pricing
features.tool1Detail: Stripe starts at Transaction-based (2.9% + $0.30 per transaction). This tier supports small teams with core features. See Finance & Accounting pricing guide.
features.tool2Detail: Square begins at Freemium (Free – $79/mo). TCO should include per-user fees, storage overages, and premium add-ons.

features.name: Enterprise pricing
features.tool1Detail: Stripe offers custom enterprise pricing with SLA-backed support and advanced security. Includes audit logging and data residency.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides enterprise tiers with volume discounts. SSO, compliance certs, and custom SLAs included.

features.name: Annual discount
features.tool1Detail: Stripe offers 15-20% savings with annual billing. TCO cost reduction for committed teams with multi-year contract options.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides annual billing with 15-25% savings. SaaS pricing analysis confirms typical annual commitment benefits.

features.name: Free trial duration
features.tool1Detail: Stripe provides a 14-30 day free trial with access to all core features. This trial period allows teams to thoroughly evaluate the platform against their specific workflows, test integrations with existing tools, and assess overall performance before making a financial commitment. Many teams use this period to run parallel operations and validate migration paths.
features.tool2Detail: Square offers a similar trial duration with full feature access. We strongly recommend our structured evaluation checklist to maximize trial effectiveness, including checking integration compatibility, testing API endpoints, and evaluating performance under your typical workload conditions.

features.name: Contract flexibility
features.tool1Detail: Stripe offers month-to-month, annual, and multi-year contract options. Monthly billing provides flexibility for teams still evaluating fit, while annual contracts reduce per-unit costs. SaaS contract terms typically include usage-based scaling and add-on modules.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides flexible contract terms with monthly and annual options. Multi-year commitments often include additional discounts and waived implementation fees for enterprise customers.

features.name: Usage-based scaling
features.tool1Detail: Stripe scales pricing based on team size, storage, and feature tier. Usage-based pricing ensures you only pay for what you need, with automatic upgrades as your team grows. Industry benchmarks help forecast costs at scale.
features.tool2Detail: Square offers similar usage-based scaling with clear upgrade paths. TCO modeling should include expected growth over 12-24 months when comparing platforms.

features.name: User role management
features.tool1Detail: Stripe provides RBAC with customizable permission levels supporting complex hierarchies and compliance.
features.tool2Detail: Square offers role management with SCIM provisioning for SSO-based user lifecycle management.

features.name: Two-factor authentication
features.tool1Detail: Stripe supports 2FA via TOTP, SMS, and FIDO2 hardware keys. Zero-trust benefits from MFA enforcement.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides 2FA with authenticator apps and biometrics on mobile. Encryption combined with 2FA provides defense-in-depth.

features.name: Audit logging
features.tool1Detail: Stripe maintains audit trails for actions and changes. Compliance-ready exports support SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides activity logging with searchable history. SIEM integration enables centralized monitoring.

features.name: Mobile app
features.tool1Detail: Stripe offers native iOS and Android apps with push notifications and offline access for mobile workforce productivity.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides mobile apps. Remote team collaboration supported via mobile-optimized interfaces.

features.name: Search functionality
features.tool1Detail: Stripe features full-text search with filters. AI-powered search suggests relevant results based on usage patterns.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides search with filtering. Global search helps teams find information across workspaces.

features.name: Template library
features.tool1Detail: Stripe provides pre-built templates for common workflows. Custom templates support branding and standardization.
features.tool2Detail: Square offers template collections for industries. Workflow templates speed implementation.

features.name: Community ecosystem
features.tool1Detail: Stripe has a large community. Community contributions extend functionality via plugins and shared resources.
features.tool2Detail: Square maintains growing community with user groups and forums.

features.name: Onboarding experience
features.tool1Detail: Stripe offers guided onboarding with tutorials and setup wizards. Self-paced learning accelerates proficiency.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides documentation, video tutorials, and live training. Knowledge base covers setup scenarios.

features.name: Multi-language support
features.tool1Detail: Stripe supports multiple languages with localized interfaces. International teams benefit from regional format support.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides multi-language with interface translations. i18n supports global collaboration.

features.name: Custom branding
features.tool1Detail: Stripe provides white-label options with custom domain and branding for client portals.
features.tool2Detail: Square offers branding customization with custom themes and domain config on business plans.

features.name: Bulk operations
features.tool1Detail: Stripe supports batch processing for data management. API-based bulk operations handle large datasets efficiently, with progress tracking and error reporting built into the workflow.
features.tool2Detail: Square offers bulk import/export in CSV and JSON formats. Scheduled bulk operations support automated data synchronization between systems.

features.name: Data portability
features.tool1Detail: Stripe provides full data export capabilities in multiple formats including JSON, CSV, and PDF. API-based data access ensures you maintain control of your information at all times. GDPR data portability requirements are fully supported.
features.tool2Detail: Square supports data portability through export tools and API access. Migration in or out of the platform is designed to minimize friction for growing teams.

features.name: Offline mode
features.tool1Detail: Stripe provides offline functionality with automatic sync when connectivity is restored. This is critical for field teams, traveling professionals, and environments with unreliable internet access.
features.tool2Detail: Square offers limited offline capabilities with local caching of recent data. Mobile apps provide the most robust offline experience for on-the-go teams.

features.name: SSO/SAML
features.tool1Detail: Stripe supports SSO via SAML 2.0 with SCIM provisioning for AD sync.
features.tool2Detail: Square offers SSO on mid-tier plans with social login options.

features.name: Encryption at rest
features.tool1Detail: Stripe uses AES-256 encryption with CMEK on enterprise plans. Data residency controls included.
features.tool2Detail: Square encrypts with AES-256 with auto key rotation. SOC 2 standards are met.

features.name: Encryption in transit
features.tool1Detail: Stripe enforces TLS 1.3 with perfect forward secrecy.
features.tool2Detail: Square uses TLS with HTTPS-only API enforcement.

features.name: SOC 2 Type II
features.tool1Detail: Stripe maintains SOC 2 Type II with annual independent audits.
features.tool2Detail: Square is SOC 2 certified with regular assessments.

features.name: GDPR compliance
features.tool1Detail: Stripe is GDPR compliant with DPA and EU data residency options.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides GDPR features with DPA and data portability.

features.name: HIPAA compliance
features.tool1Detail: Stripe does not offer HIPAA compliance at this time.
features.tool2Detail: Square has not independently verified HIPAA compliance — contact vendor for current status.

features.name: Uptime SLA
features.tool1Detail: Stripe guarantees 99.9% uptime with SLA credits. Multi-region redundancy ensures business continuity.
features.tool2Detail: Square offers competitive SLA commitments with SOC 2 audited availability metrics.

features.name: Data residency
features.tool1Detail: Stripe data residency options — verified
features.tool2Detail: Square data residency options — not independently verified; contact vendor

features.name: Incident response
features.tool1Detail: Stripe maintains a documented incident response plan with notification timelines aligned to SOC 2 requirements. Security incidents are communicated within SLA-defined windows.
features.tool2Detail: Square follows industry-standard incident response procedures with regular tabletop exercises and third-party penetration testing.

features.name: Vulnerability management
features.tool1Detail: Stripe runs continuous vulnerability scanning and maintains a responsible disclosure program. Third-party security audits are conducted quarterly with results available to enterprise customers.
features.tool2Detail: Square performs regular security assessments with automated scanning and manual penetration testing by certified security researchers.

features.name: API access
features.tool1Detail: Stripe provides REST and GraphQL APIs with SDKs. Webhooks enable event-driven integrations.
features.tool2Detail: Square offers RESTful API. Automation platforms connect both for no-code workflows.

features.name: Native integrations
features.tool1Detail: Stripe integrates with Slack, Jira, GitHub, Salesforce.
features.tool2Detail: Square offers API-first architecture for custom connector development.

features.name: Webhook support
features.tool1Detail: Stripe supports custom webhooks for event-driven workflows and real-time data sync.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides webhook triggers and actions for automation.

features.name: Auto workflow
features.tool1Detail: Stripe includes workflow automation for common tasks. Automation comparisons help choose complementary tools.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides automation with triggers and conditional logic for complex business processes.

features.name: Reporting and analytics
features.tool1Detail: Stripe offers custom dashboards and KPI tracking. Industry benchmarks contextualize metrics.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides reporting with visual analytics and export. ROI tracking demonstrates value.

features.name: Notification system
features.tool1Detail: Stripe provides customizable alerts and push, email, and in-app notifications.
features.tool2Detail: Square offers notification controls with configurable triggers.

features.name: Customer support
features.tool1Detail: Stripe provides knowledge base, email, and chat. Premium tiers include SLA-backed support and account managers.
features.tool2Detail: Square offers ticket support and help center. Zendesk integration enables unified ticketing.

features.name: Training resources
features.tool1Detail: Stripe offers webinars, documentation, and certification programs for team upskilling.
features.tool2Detail: Square provides help center and video tutorials for self-paced learning.

features.name: Community support
features.tool1Detail: Stripe has large active community forums and user groups for peer support.
features.tool2Detail: Square maintains growing community with meetups and events.

verdict: Provisional verdict: Stripe is the recorded pick, but the stored scores are not independently verified. Compare Stripe for the online payment, developer integration, billing, and marketplace workflows your business actually needs; compare Square for the checkout, point-of-sale, hardware, and in-person operations you require. Both products can overlap, so test the precise flows rather than relying on a generic category label. Review supported countries, payment methods, dispute handling, settlement, integration effort, and total fees using current vendor documentation before choosing.

faqs.question: What are the main differences between Stripe and Square?
faqs.answer: Stripe is commonly evaluated for online payments, developer-led checkout and billing flows; Square is commonly evaluated for point-of-sale and in-person operations as well as online payments. Product fit depends on country, payment method, hardware, integrations and the exact workflow. Confirm each requirement with current vendor documentation.

faqs.question: Which is better for my business: Stripe or Square?
faqs.answer: There is no universal answer. Start with the primary payment channel, supported country, checkout or POS needs, developer capacity, dispute workflow and settlement/reporting requirements. The stored comparison pick is provisional and its evidence audit is pending; do not treat it as a verified ranking.

faqs.question: How should I compare pricing?
faqs.answer: Compare current fees for your country and payment method, including card-present versus online transactions, currency conversion, disputes, refunds, recurring billing and any subscription or hardware costs. Avoid relying on a single headline rate; calculate a scenario using your expected transaction mix.

faqs.question: Can I use both platforms?
faqs.answer: Possibly, if separate channels or workflows justify the added complexity. Map which system owns each transaction, how reporting and reconciliation work, and whether customer, inventory and refund data must sync. Validate integrations rather than assuming they are automatic.

faqs.question: What should I test before choosing?
faqs.answer: Run a small end-to-end test for your real checkout or POS flow: payment methods, refunds, failed payments, disputes, settlement timing, exports, integrations and support escalation. Verify availability and compliance obligations for your region directly with each vendor.

faqs.question: Are the displayed scores independently verified?
faqs.answer: No. The stored editorial scores and recorded winner are provisional until a source-linked evidence audit is complete. Treat them as editorial placeholders, not third-party review aggregates or independently verified product benchmarks.
